name: Outlaw Tools v0.12.0
body:
# Outlaw Tools v0.12.0

Public downloads for Outlaw Tools by Orbital Outlaws. Mining Scanner is the first complete module in the wider companion app.

Product home: https://www.orbitaloutlaws.tv/

Source repository: private (PattrnData/Outlaw-Tools)

# Outlaw Tools v0.12.0

## Equipment Prices

- Look up shop quotes directly by a verified game UUID, without depending on a changeable provider route ID or item-registry response. Reject conflicting identities and ambiguous multi-item responses; retain prior quotes as stale on failure.
- Retain provider terminal/system IDs and show the supplied system beside the shop name. Provider locations remain public reference evidence, not verified game route stops.

## Marketplace History

- Changing an item, mode, date range or QL band returns to the first cached page, avoiding misleading empty later pages.
- Show returned observation counts and explain capped newest-first results. Narrow the existing date/QL filters and refresh; Next only pages cached observations.
- Distinguish an absent cache, a successful empty query and returned observations without a matching identity. Observations remain separate from completed sales.

## Local Data

- Existing styling, bounded public GET worker, offline cache and exact decimal prices retained. No player-data migration, new service, dependencies or player-data upload.

## Downloads

- Windows installer and Linux x86_64 archive, with SHA-256 checksums.
